The examples on this page use gene expression data from
@khan2001classification,
who measured 2308 genes in tissue samples from children with small round blue cell tumors.
The samples fall into four tumor classes, numbered 1 to 4 in the data.
This site keeps a copy of the 63 training samples at [`data/khan.csv`](data/khan.csv),
taken from the `Khan` data of the R package
[`ISLR2`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=ISLR2) [@james2021islr2e]:
the column `tumor_class` holds the class,
and the columns `gene_1` to `gene_2308` hold the expression values.
The examples compare classes 2 and 4.

```{r}
#| label: load-khan
#| code-fold: false
khan <- read.csv("data/khan.csv")
khan_pair <- khan[khan$tumor_class %in% c(2, 4), ]
table(tumor_class = khan_pair$tumor_class)
```
